qa_flags.question: Analyst (Julio Romero) asked whether the pool of partners/customers the company works with has increased, or whether growth is from doing more with existing customers.
qa_flags.response_pattern: First response from management addressed a different topic (Comfort Systems subsidiary companies collaborating/sharing workforce with each other), not the customer pool; the analyst had to explicitly rephrase ('I'm sorry to rephrase my question...') before getting a direct answer about customer concentration/repeat business preference.
